concept.idea_en: the pet inspects the delivery for you
concept.scene: 画面中下部放着一个刚拆开的快递纸箱，箱盖向两边翻开。一只真实的橘色小猫从箱子里钻出半个身子，两只前爪扒着箱沿，歪着头好奇地看着镜头，像在认真验收刚到的东西。箱子旁边散着一个毛线球和一根小骨头玩具。
concept.scene_en: In the lower middle of the poster sits a freshly opened cardboard delivery box with its flaps folded out. A real orange kitten pops half its body out of the box, both front paws gripping the rim, head tilted, looking curiously at the viewer as if carefully inspecting a new delivery. A small yarn ball and a little bone toy lie beside the box.
concept.interlock: 标题“毛孩子先验货”在上方分两行居中。小猫竖起的左耳尖挡在第二行“验”字的左下角前面，最多盖住这个字的五分之一，其余的字完整露出
concept.interlock_en: The headline sits above in two centred lines. The tip of the kitten's raised left ear stands in front of the lower left corner of the character 验 on the second line, covering at most a fifth of it; every other character stays fully visible.
concept.headline_style: 超大号圆润粗黑字，深可可色，两行居中
concept.headline_style_en: huge rounded heavy Chinese characters in deep cocoa brown, two centred lines
concept.look: 柔和的奶油粉底色，柔光棚拍，小猫和纸箱是真实照片质感，毛发清晰，背景干净，只有很淡的圆点，整体温柔治愈
concept.look_en: Soft creamy pink background, gentle studio light, the kitten and box photographed with fine fur detail, clean backdrop with only very faint dots, warm and soothing.
